Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/CorsairLightingNodeController): OpenRGB's own CorsairLightingNodeController and RGBController_CorsairLightingNode compiled (g++) with stub headers for hidapi, the logger, threads and the device guard, and driven by a harness in the porting session's scratch space (openrgb-work/batch2/corsair-ln/driver.cpp; not part of the repository). plugin.js was never run to make them. initialize = the constructors (firmware request); frame_a / frame_b = RGBController_CorsairLightingNode::DeviceUpdateLEDs in Direct mode, i.e. SetChannelLEDs(channel, colours) for channel 1 then 2 with the colours given (channelN_a / _b, one [r, g, b] per LED); shutdown = Lightloom's exit, built from OpenRGB's own packet functions: SendPortState(0, hardware), SendPortState(1, hardware), SendCommit. 'answers': whether the scripted device answers reads (16 bytes) or never. ops: write = output report (hid_write), read = input report read (hid_read_timeout with the C++ length and timeout); hex is the whole buffer, report id first.
